prompt:
Image 1 is a flat lay of a Gymnastics kit, photographed from the front.

Photograph THAT SAME KIT from the BACK — the same garments, turned over:
- the shirt, laid flat and face DOWN, so its back is what you see
- the shorts below it, also turned so their back is what you see
EXACTLY ONE of each. No socks, no shoes, no ball, nothing else in the frame.

Everything carries over from image 1 unchanged: the same colours, the same fabric, the
same cut, the same collar, and above all the SAME PANELS AND
TRIM — a stripe, a panel or a piping that exists on the front continues around to the
back exactly as the garment's construction would carry it. Nothing is added that image 1
does not have, and nothing that image 1 has quietly disappears.

SLEEVES: this is the same garment as image 1, so it has exactly the same sleeves. If the
shirt in image 1 has short sleeves, this one has short sleeves and is NOT a sleeveless
vest or a tank top. If image 1 is sleeveless, this one is sleeveless. Look at image 1 and
copy what is there.

THE KIT — these are settled decisions, not suggestions. Do not substitute anything.
- shirt: A POWDER BLUE LONG-SLEEVED gymnastics LEOTARD exactly as photo2.png shows it: a V-neck edged in ROYAL BLUE; across the chest a CHEVRON pointing DOWN to a point at the sternum, made of a WHITE band with a ROYAL BLUE band directly below it; the same white-then-royal-blue chevron repeated at each CUFF, so each wrist ends in a royal blue band. The body of the leotard is plain powder blue, high-cut at the legs. The number 0 sits on the OUTSIDE of her LEFT UPPER SLEEVE near the shoulder, drawn as a WHITE OUTLINE with the powder blue showing inside it. A small WHITE SCRIPT MAKER'S MARK sits low on her LEFT HIP — her own kit's mark, small and soft-edged, never enlarged and never redrawn. No club name, no player name, no sponsor.
- shorts: There is NO separate lower garment and NO tights with this kit: the leotard IS the whole competition uniform, and her LEGS ARE BARE from the high-cut hip to the floor, exactly as photo2.png shows her on the competition floor.
- socks: NO SOCKS. Nothing on the feet or the ankles in any frame. No photograph shows her feet, so this is a stated DECISION and it follows the sport: artistic gymnasts compete and train barefoot.
- footwear: NO FOOTWEAR OF ANY KIND — bare feet and bare ankles. No photograph shows her feet, so this is a stated DECISION, and it is the one the sport's own rules make: no shoes, no slippers, no beam shoes are drawn in any frame. Stated as an absolute because a sport whose athletes wear nothing on their feet is exactly where a model invents a shoe if the line stays silent.
- equipment: CHALK, and nothing else on her: white gymnastics chalk dusted over both palms and fingers, with a little on the forearms and the sleeve cuffs, exactly as photo2.png shows. NO hand grips, NO wristbands, NO tape, NO jewellery — she wears none in any photograph. As for apparatus: her own photographs are taken in a gym full of it (she is sitting on a beam in photo3), but the DECISION for the generated frames is that she is photographed ALONE against a plain backdrop with NO beam, NO bars and NO vault in the picture, because these frames are cut out and dropped onto a card.
- Where an item above is described from the athlete's own photographs, any manufacturer's
  logo it genuinely carries stays on it — that is their real clothing.
- The club crest sits a CIRCULAR badge on HER LEFT CHEST — the wearer's left, high on the leotard above the white chevron and beside the neckline, about the width of two fingers, exactly where and how large photo2.png shows it. It is never centred on the chest and never enlarged. That position is settled and is the same in every frame.

THE BACK OF THE SHIRT carries the squad number 0, plus whatever else the
kit description above explicitly gives it — and nothing more. Add no mark the description
does not name.
NEVER any lettering: no club name, no player name, no sponsor, no word of any kind.
Nothing sits inside, on top of or overlapping the numerals — a badge, if the description
calls for one, is small, clear of the number, and the right way round.

Hard requirements:
- Everything is BRAND NEW and immaculate: no dirt, no scuffs, no wear, no sweat marks.
- Flat lay from directly overhead. No mannequin, no person, no body, no hanger, no rail.
- The same plain light grey surface and the same even lighting as image 1.
- No text of any kind beyond the number, no labels, no neck tag, no watermark.
- Sharp throughout, photographic, print quality. Square image.
